title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.3 (Peaked November 23, 2026 at 19:41 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 23, 2026 at 06:30 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 313 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)

A little flicker from the Sun! 🔥

A broad dark coronal-hole region stands out in today’s EUV solar images, while no clear large outward coronal structure is visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
